description: This file implements the 'git replace' command, providing functionality for listing, deleting, editing, grafting, and converting replace references in a Git repository. It includes functions for managing replace refs, exporting/importing objects, and creating graft commits.

methods.name: show_reference
methods.description: Displays reference information in different formats based on the specified pattern and format.

methods.name: list_replace_refs
methods.description: Lists replace references matching a pattern in specified format.

methods.name: for_each_replace_name
methods.description: Iterates over provided arguments, resolving refs and applying a callback function.

methods.name: delete_replace_ref
methods.description: Deletes a replace ref and confirms deletion.

methods.name: check_ref_valid
methods.description: Validates if a ref name is valid and does not already exist unless forced.

methods.name: replace_object_oid
methods.description: Replaces an object reference with a new object, updating refs transactionally.

methods.name: replace_object
methods.description: Resolves object refs and calls replace_object_oid.

methods.name: export_object
methods.description: Exports an object to a file, raw or pretty-printed.

methods.name: import_object
methods.description: Imports an object from a file, interpreting it as a specific type.

methods.name: edit_and_replace
methods.description: Exports an object, allows editing via editor, then imports and replaces it.

methods.name: replace_parents
methods.description: Replaces parent commits in a commit buffer.

methods.name: check_one_mergetag
methods.description: Checks if a mergetag in a commit matches expected tags.

methods.name: create_graft
methods.description: Creates a graft commit by replacing parents in an existing commit.

methods.name: convert_graft_file
methods.description: Converts an existing graft file into refs.

methods.name: cmd_replace
methods.description: Main command handler for 'git replace', dispatching subcommands based on options.
